backends.launch: Launch pinned Chromium through the Rust-owned Playwright broker.
backends.cdp: Connect to an existing Chrome/Chromium endpoint via KLAUS_BROWSER_CDP_ENDPOINT.
backends.persistent: Launch a persistent Chromium/Chrome profile via KLAUS_BROWSER_USER_DATA_DIR.
backends.extension: Connect to the bundled extension through the authenticated local WebSocket bridge.

registry.agent.browsers.get: Returns the built-in browser for browser, klaus-bundled or iab, an external browser for a stable chrome:<profile> id, or resolves {mention} through the owning host.
registry.agent.browsers.getForUrl: Returns the bundled browser for the requested URL.
registry.agent.browsers.list: Lists available browser descriptors with runtime capabilities.

browser.documentation: Returns runtime docs and this API reference.
browser.nameSession: Names the current browser automation session.
browser.listConnectedBrowsers: Lists connected browser instances visible to the runtime bridge.
browser.selectBrowser: Selects a connected browser by deviceId.
browser.switchBrowser: Requests or selects a browser instance for subsequent automation.
browser.user.openTabs: Lists host-visible user tabs for this exact browser; external tabs are distinct from task-owned tabs.
browser.user.claimTab: Claims an external user tab through the dedicated claim_tab ownership operation and returns the existing controllable tab.
browser.user.history: Lists browser history entries visible to the runtime.
browser.tabs.get: Selects a tab by id, or resolves {mention: completePluginUri} through the host and returns the exact claimed tab. Every subsequent operation targets its resolved browserId and tabId.
browser.tabs.new: Creates a new tab and optionally opens a URL.
browser.tabs.content: Loads URLs in temporary tabs and extracts content without changing the selected tab.
browser.tabs.finalize: Closes tabs that are not needed.

tab.snapshot: Read DOM/text and interactive element snapshots.
tab.readPage: Read an accessibility-style element tree with stable refs.
tab.find: Find elements by text, role, label, selector, or purpose.
tab.formInput: Set a form value by ref.
tab.fileUpload: Upload one or more local files through a file input selector or ref.
tab.uploadImage: Upload a local image through a file input selector.
tab.gifCreator: Capture a GIF artifact or frame-backed recording artifact.
tab.shortcuts.list: List shortcuts or workflows exposed by the browser/page/runtime.
tab.shortcuts.execute: Execute a shortcut or workflow by name.
tab.content.export: Export tab content to a runtime artifact or content string.
tab.content.exportGsuite: Export tab content using a Google Workspace-style output type when supported.
tab.downloadMedia: Download linked or media content from a selector, coordinate, or URL.
tab.clipboard.read: Read clipboard items from the browser session.
tab.clipboard.readText: Read plain text from the browser session clipboard.
tab.clipboard.write: Write clipboard items to the browser session.
tab.clipboard.writeText: Write plain text to the browser session clipboard.
tab.getJsDialog: Read the active JavaScript dialog, if any, and return accept/dismiss controls.
tab.markDeliverable: Keep this tab as a deliverable after cleanup.
tab.markHandoff: Keep this tab available for later handoff.
tab.title: Read the current tab title.
tab.computer: Drive mouse, keyboard, wait, scroll, screenshot, zoom, hover, or drag actions.
tab.type: Type text by selector or keyboard focus.
tab.batch: Run sequential browser operations in one request.
tab.playwright.waitForEvent: Wait for download or filechooser events and return first-stage helper objects.
tab.playwright.waitForLoadState: Wait for load, domcontentloaded, networkidle, or commit state.
tab.playwright.waitForTimeout: Wait for a fixed number of milliseconds.
tab.playwright.waitForURL: Wait until the tab reaches a matching URL.
tab.playwright.domSnapshot: Return a DOM snapshot string for locator construction and retry decisions.
tab.playwright.elementInfo: Return locator-oriented metadata for elements at a selector or viewport coordinate.
tab.playwright.elementScreenshot: Capture an element or coordinate-focused screenshot artifact.
